I replied to Kwame in your DM (DGBRAIN0002). I did not set up the 09:00 digest.

My scheduling tool can only create local jobs, and their output doesn't reach a DM like this one. So I told Kwame that I can't run the recurring digest. I offered two alternatives: he can message "digest" each morning and I'll summarise #coastal-team since his last request, or I can run one now for a period he names.

I did not check #coastal-team, since no digest was requested.
